# Nubia KC Estates Ltd

> Property management, lettings and sales company in Nairobi, Kenya, serving apartment owners, individual landlords (1 to 10 units), diaspora property owners, and real estate investors and developers.

AI and LLM crawlers may read and summarise the public pages listed below. The same pages are open to search engines in robots.txt; /app.html and /source/ are internal files and should not be indexed.

## Key facts
- Services: tenant management (sourcing, vetting, leases, rent enforcement), financial management (M-Pesa and bank rent collection, monthly statements, arrears tracking), property maintenance (inspections, repairs, preventive planning).
- Management fee: 8% of rent collected.
- Areas: Kilimani, Westlands, Ngong Road, Juja, Thika and Murang'a.
- Leadership: Lynne Chepchumba (Founder), Kenneth Mworia (Chief Executive Officer), Paul Chimatuni (Director).
- Office: Crescent Business Centre, Parklands, Nairobi, Kenya.
- Phone and WhatsApp: +254 703 277 912
- Email: info@nubiakcestates.co.ke
